Ettinger's connection with Kindler. ,, 503.

ETTINGER 90 301
描述：身高5英尺8英寸，体格健壮，面色红润，面部光洁无须；约35岁，步态懒散呈红褐色（注：此处原文“reddish brown”修饰walk可能指代某种特征或为OCR错误，暂直译），衣着邋遢。德国受保护人

据称埃廷格（Ettinger）雇用妇女走私鸦片；因德国领事施压而支付其房租；据称在垦业银行（Bank of Territorial Development）存有25,000.00美元。档案号 501。
埃廷格与金德勒（Kindler）的关系。 ,, 503。
据称埃廷格出售了500支手枪。警方未能找到交易证据。约瑟菲（Josefi）提供情报称，鲁菲奥（Rufio）和埃廷格正在购买制造爆炸物的原料。档案号 544。
,, 监视时间从16年9月23日至16年10月3日。 ,, 626。
埃廷格与鲁菲奥和约瑟菲（Josephi）关系友好。后者与埃廷格于1914年初解散了橡胶修理店的合伙关系。档案号 821。

C. I. D.
I. C. REG 301
No. Lett ............
Date ......... 18/5/16

FILED
COPY.

May 15th

Sir,
A. Ettinger of 30 D Nanking Road has a sum of $25,000.00 deposited in current account in the Bank of Territorial Development. This money he has squeezed from the amounts paid to him by the German Consul for espionage purposes and he has placed it in the Bank of Territorial Development because the Foreign Secretary of that establishment, Mr. Ezra, a Bagdad Jew, is a friend of his who is aiding him in concealing the whereabouts of his deposits from the knowledge of the German Consulate.
Ettinger when he is instructed to despatch some one on a mission to the territory of the allies, makes an estimate of the cost, receives the amount from the Consulate, hands it to his agent less a third and in some cases a half, and makes the recipient sign an acknowledgement in full, which is later passed on to the Consulate. This procedure is not followed in all cases because the Consul or his representative on some occasions sees the emissary himself and in these instances there is no commission for Ettinger whose loyalty his employers are now beginning to doubt.
Ettinger with others is carrying on a considerable trade in making false passports which are sold at a big profit. The paper on which the Consular signatures are forged, is genuine and must be abstracted from the Consulates whose stamp it bears. The Spanish and Norwegian Consulates, are two of those mentioned, and a quantity of British Consular paper is alleged to be in possession of E.H.Berthel whose brother utilised a portion of it when he went away on the s.s. China on May 8th.
The above information has been supplied to H.B.M's Consulate by an informer.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

刑事侦缉处 (C. I. D.)
I. C. REG 301
信函编号 ............
日期 ......... 1916年5月18日

已归档
副本。

5月15日

先生，
住在南京路30D号的A. 埃廷格（A. Ettinger）在垦业银行（Bank of Territorial Development）的活期账户中存有一笔25,000.00美元的款项。这笔钱是他从德国领事支付给他的间谍活动经费中克扣下来的，他将其存入垦业银行，是因为该行的外籍秘书以斯拉（Ezra）先生是一位巴格达犹太人，也是他的朋友，正协助他向德国领事馆隐瞒其存款的下落。
当埃廷格受命派遣人员前往协约国领土执行任务时，他会估算费用，从领事馆领取全额款项，然后将其中的三分之二（在某些情况下为一半）交给他的代理人，并让收款人签署全额收据，该收据随后被转交给领事馆。并非所有情况都遵循此程序，因为领事或其代表有时会亲自会见使者，在这些情况下，埃廷格无法抽取佣金，而他的雇主现在开始怀疑他的忠诚度。
埃廷格与其他人一起从事伪造护照的大量交易，并以高额利润出售。伪造领事签名的纸张是真实的，必须从其加盖印章的领事馆窃取。文中提到的有两个是西班牙和挪威领事馆，另有指控称E.H.贝特尔（E.H.Berthel）持有大量英国领事馆专用纸，其兄弟在5月8日乘坐“中国”号轮船（s.s. China）离开时使用了其中一部分。
上述信息由一名线人提供给大英帝国陛下领事馆。

您顺从的仆人，

首席探长。

警务处总监。

Form 27 34
Shanghai Municipal Police.
C: I. D.
F: O REG
No. 201
Date 11/5/16
Hongkew Station.
April 26th 1918.
REPORT ON Suspected storing of smuggled opium.
FILED
Made by D.S.I. Reeves. Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector.
Chief Detective Inspector.
Sir,
Re the question of the selling of
smuggled opium by licensed opium shops, there is besides these,
several men engaged in other businesses who have the reputation
of purchasing the opium brought in by firemen Etc from ships that
arrive here from London and Dalny, and it is suspected that these
men have quantities of the drug stored on their premises. A man
we have the most suspicion against is a second hand dealer named
Nam Kam Kee No 48 Seward Road. This man has had the reputation
for months past as a big dealer in smuggled opium, and I have good
reason to believe that if his house and shop was searched we would
find a quantity of the drug. Besides Chinese, there are several
foreigners who we suspect deal in smuggled opium . Mr C. Biddle
was charged in the American Court with smuggling and fined, Mr
Ettinguer 30D Nanzing Road has the reputation of sending women
up North to smuggle through opium to Shanghai. Ettinguer is a
registered German subject.
I am Sir,
Your obedient Servant.
Percy. H. Reeves.
D.S.I.

表格 27 34
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
刑事侦缉处 (C: I. D.)
F: O REG
编号 201
日期 1916年5月11日
虹口巡捕房。
1918年4月26日。
关于涉嫌储存走私鸦片的报告。
已归档
由副首席探长里夫斯（Reeves）撰写。由首席探长转发。
首席探长。
先生，
关于持牌鸦片烟馆销售走私鸦片的问题，除了这些烟馆外，还有几名从事其他行业的人，他们素有从抵达此地的来自伦敦和大连（Dalny）的船只上，向消防员等人收购运入的鸦片的名声，且怀疑这些人在其处所内储存了大量毒品。我们最怀疑的一名男子是住在西华德路48号的二手商南金记（Nam Kam Kee）。此人过去几个月来一直有大肆贩卖走私鸦片的名声，我有充分理由相信，如果搜查他的住房和店铺，我们会发现大量毒品。除了中国人，我们还怀疑有几名外国人参与走私鸦片交易。C. 比德尔（C. Biddle）先生曾在美籍法庭被控走私并被罚款，住在南京路30D号的埃廷格（Ettinguer）先生素有派遣妇女北上通过陆路将鸦片走私至上海的名声。埃廷格是一名登记的德国籍民。
先生，
您顺从的仆人。
珀西·H·里夫斯（Percy. H. Reeves）。
副首席探长。

Form 2 ; 34
Shanghai Municipal Police.
301
7/5/16
Hongkew Station.
May 5th 191 6.
REPORT ON t.ouble over Ettinger and the Non payment of his rent.
Made by D.S.I.Reeves, Forwarded by [Signature]
Chief Detective Inspector,
Sir,
To-day I interviewed Bro. Mouly
re Ettinger and the non-payment of the rent for his house No 30
D. Nanzing Road, and I was informed by him that after he had
seen the French Consul and the Police, and finding that nothing
could be done, he wrote a letter to the German Consul and report-
ed that Ettinger had not paid his rent and refused to leave the
house. The German Consul wrote him a very nice letter back
and made Ettinger pay up, and also told Brother Mouly to report
to him if there was any further trouble with the man. As Ettinger
is now paying his rent, Brother Mouly prefers to let the man remain
there, than having to resort to measures to get rid of him.
I am Sir,
Your obedient servant.
Percy. A. Reeves.
D.S.I.
[Signature]
2/6.
[Signature] Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
301
1916年5月7日
虹口巡捕房。
1916年5月5日。
关于埃廷格及其拖欠房租引发纠纷的报告。
由副首席探长里夫斯（Reeves）撰写，由 [签名] 转发
首席探长，
先生，
今天我就会埃廷格及其位于南京路30D号房屋的欠租问题采访了穆利神父（Bro. Mouly），他告知我，在他会见法国领事和警方并发现无计可施后，他致信德国领事，报告埃廷格未付房租并拒绝搬离该房屋。德国领事给他回了一封非常客气的信，并迫使埃廷格付清了款项，还告诉穆利神父，如果此人再惹麻烦就向他报告。由于埃廷格现在正在支付房租，穆利神父宁愿让他留在那里，也不愿采取驱逐措施。
先生，
您顺从的仆人。
珀西·A·里夫斯（Percy. A. Reeves）。
副首席探长。
[签名]
2/6.
[签名] 阿姆斯特朗（Armstrong）
首席探长。
